_description: Out-of-domain test set (600 news sentences, Chakma -> Bangla). Beam search 5, max_new_tokens 128, one sentence at a time. BLEU = sacreBLEU, chrF = chrF (word_order 0), METEOR x 100. Thesis Table 5.1.

bootstrap_sentence_bleu._note: Mean sentence-BLEU (0-1 scale), 10,000 resamples, seed 42. p_value 0.0 means no resample showed B <= A (p < 0.0001).

baseline_chapter4_trainer_eval._note: Thesis Chapter 4 numbers from Seq2SeqTrainer.evaluate (batched, max_length 128); chrF here is chrF++ and METEOR is 0-1.
